meta.title: Modore — A local audit of what your AI agents left behind
meta.description: A local, deterministic, metadata-only audit of Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, and AI IDE session traces — retention forecasts, orphaned sessions, and sole-copy worktrees, with no LLM anywhere in the judgment path. Modore also explains the PC that feels busy for no reason: miner suspicion, autoruns, and Korean banking-plugin false positives, with traffic-light reports and hash-only VirusTotal lookup.

hero.title: A local audit of what your AI agents left behind.
hero.subtitle: On a Mac where Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, or an AI IDE has been working, Modore answers the questions no other tool asks: which sessions touched which projects, which transcripts quietly expire in days, and which worktrees hold the only copy of unpushed work — deterministically, with no LLM in the judgment path. The same evidence-first approach also covers the PC that feels busy for no reason.

preview.accessible_summary: Example scan result: 3 items to review, 0 threats, and 93 safe items

scree.heading: A deterministic map of what agents left behind.
scree.lead: scree joins Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and VS Code-fork session stores by workspace and repository — metadata-only, no LLM anywhere in the judgment path. Every verdict is preview-grade evidence with an explicit revalidation duty.

join.title: Cross-tool join
join.desc: Which tools touched which workspace/repository, when — across Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and VS Code-fork stores.

retention.title: Retention forecast
retention.desc: Per-store rolling windows estimated from file ages, with D-day flags for sessions about to expire inside still-active projects.

sole_copy.title: Sole-copy judgment
sole_copy.desc: Agent worktrees and primary checkouts stranded off main: protected (dirty or unpushed) versus rebuildable, from read-only git evidence.

lineage.title: Orphans & lineage
lineage.desc: Sessions pointing at vanished workspaces, and every remembered work path classified alive+git / alive+plain / vanished.

contract.title: No-content-leak contract
contract.desc: Leading JSONL lines are decoded in memory but message content is never retained or emitted; nested transcripts are attributed by stat() without being opened — pinned by tests.

problem.heading: Why is my PC this busy?
problem.lead: A slow PC, spinning fans, high CPU/GPU, and unknown startup entries create real anxiety. A Korean PC also carries banking, government, and e-commerce security plugins that often look suspicious. Modore gathers evidence before you ignore everything or delete the wrong thing.

how.heading: 8 diagnostics → 1 HTML report.
how.lead: No tracking installer. OS-specific scripts collect system state, then Windows assembles an HTML report while Mac uses a system-component SwiftUI utility plus HTML export.

p1.title: Collect
p1.desc: Processes, network, ports, autoruns, security posture. Sysinternals + launchd + VirusTotal hash lookup.

p2.title: Normalize
p2.desc: Match against Korean software whitelist, assign traffic-light verdict. OS-agnostic schema.

p3.title: Render
p3.desc: Windows gets a single HTML report. Mac gets a native SwiftUI utility plus HTML export. No tracking installer or report upload.

privacy.heading: Don't take "we're safe" on faith — read the code.
privacy.lead: Every network call is in the source. VirusTotal lookups send only the SHA-256 hash; file contents never leave your machine. Here's the actual call site.

hash.title: Hash only, no file upload
hash.desc: Get-FileHash computes SHA-256 locally. The GET request carries just the hash. If the hash is unknown, we return "unknown" — we never upload the file.

telemetry.title: Zero telemetry
telemetry.desc: No usage stats, no error reports, nothing sent to us. Diagnostic runtime outbound calls are limited to opt-in VirusTotal lookups and optional Sysinternals downloads.

local.title: Local cache only
local.desc: VT responses cache in %LOCALAPPDATA% (Windows) or ~/Library/Caches (macOS) for 48h. No cloud account, no sync.

audit.title: Source you can read
audit.desc: Readable PowerShell · Bash · JXA source. Release zips do not bundle prebuilt diagnostic binaries. grep -R 'Invoke-RestMethod\|Invoke-WebRequest\|curl\|virustotal.com/api' scripts/ finds outbound calls.

download.heading: Review and build the source.
download.lead: No public installer is available yet. Run the reviewed source, or wait for a release with signing, notarization, Gatekeeper, and SHA-256 metadata.

windows.title: Windows Edition
windows.desc: Windows 10 / 11 · PowerShell 5.1. Review the source, then run scan.bat.

macos.title: Mac Edition
macos.desc: macOS 13+ SwiftUI app via run-mac-app.command; script mode via scan.command → Open. The AI-agent session audit (scree) and System Data/Developer storage decoding are Mac Edition features.

download.github_side: Clone or fork: github.com/heznpc/modore. Inspect the readable source yourself.

closing.lead: No sign-up, no email, no upload — verify it yourself.
